stories.title: Implement Flipkart credential runtime foundation
acceptance: Flipkart connector can resolve encrypted client, refresh, and cached access tokens from connector_credentials.
Flipkart validateCredentials performs real token refresh logic and records credential health without logging secrets.
Flipkart handleOAuthCallback exchanges an authorization code and persists encrypted access and refresh tokens.
Flipkart validateProduct returns seller-readable LOCAL_RULES errors and warnings aligned with current field requirements.
Flipkart normaliseError maps known provider codes to seller-readable messages with deterministic fallback handling.

stories.title: Route queued Flipkart jobs through the real connector publish path
acceptance: Flipkart publishProduct performs a real token-authenticated provider request and returns a deterministic external submission reference.
Marketplace export-job processing routes publish-capable Flipkart jobs through ConnectorFrameworkService.publish instead of recording a simulation-only pending row.
Connector submissions store LIVE_API source and provider externalRef for a successful Flipkart publish initiation.
The first end-to-end integration proof covers category setup, mapping publish, export-job processing, and live connector submission creation.

stories.title: Add manual Flipkart submission status sync on top of the live publish path
acceptance: ConnectorFrameworkService exposes a bounded STATUS_SYNC execution path for connectors that support polling.
Flipkart syncSubmissionStatus polls the provider with the published SKU and maps provider states into connector submission statuses.
Marketplace submissions can be manually synced through the submissions API without introducing a new queue or scheduler path.
A full integration proof covers live publish initiation followed by manual provider-backed status sync to a terminal submission state.

stories.title: Automatically requeue pending Flipkart submissions for provider-backed status resolution
acceptance: Pending Flipkart connector submissions schedule a bounded delayed status-sync job immediately after live publish initiation.
The existing connector-submission queue can execute both export-job work and connector status-sync work without introducing a new queue or scheduler.
Automatic Flipkart status resolution reuses the published submission SKU lookup and updates connector_submissions to a terminal state without manual intervention.
Worker backpressure validation still passes after delayed queue support is added to the shared queue service.

stories.title: Support Flipkart credential capture and validation through the normal connector install flow
acceptance: Flipkart installs can optionally capture client ID, client secret, and refresh token through the normal connector install endpoint without changing other connector install contracts.
Supplied Flipkart credentials are encrypted on write and validated before the install returns success.
Invalid supplied Flipkart credentials fail the install cleanly and do not leave connector_installations or connector_credentials artifacts behind.
The connectors page renders masked Flipkart credential fields and surfaces install-time validation failures without exposing secrets.
Existing Flipkart publish and status-sync proofs still pass after the install flow gains credential capture.

stories.title: Add workspace-scoped login with tenant directory resolution
acceptance: Login requires a workspace slug in addition to user ID and password.
Workspace slug resolves to tenantId server-side before credentials are validated.
JWT/session claim shape, cookie names, tenant middleware, and downstream tenant-scoped queries remain unchanged.
Lockout and resend-unlock flows are scoped by workspaceSlug plus userId.
Platform admin can provision tenant workspace slugs through an API-only surface.

stories.title: Prevent empty-body connector revoke requests from sending JSON content-type
acceptance: DELETE requests without a body do not send a default application/json content type.
Connector permission revoke no longer fails with Body cannot be empty when content-type is set to application/json.
The shared deleteJson helper remains available to connector access and template delete flows.
